evals.name: routine-tidy
evals.prompt: 帮我把下载和桌面整理一下，按 ~/Files 那套规则来，截图收件箱也一起清掉。我已经同意直接执行，不用再问我。
evals.expected_output: Existing Root is used. Each item is filed by precedence: a key file into 99_sensitive, an invoice and a receipt screenshot (identified by viewing it) and an expense CSV (identified by reading it) into 30_finance, a health report into 10_personal. One of two byte-identical CSVs goes to the OS trash. A verified Manifest is written and anything left behind is named in the report.
files: fixture: Downloads with invoice, uninstalled-app dmg, duplicate expense CSVs, api-keys.txt, docx, mp4; Desktop with a receipt screenshot PNG and a health report; 00_inbox with a screen recording
assertions: Every item left in an Inbox or on the Desktop is named in the report
Receipt screenshot (readable image) is filed under 30_finance
Expense CSV (readable text) is filed under 30_finance
api-keys.txt is in Files/99_sensitive
Invoice is in Files/30_finance
Health report is in Files/10_personal
No file lost: every original file's content still exists in the sandbox (Trash included)
Duplicate CSV: one copy kept in Files, the other in Trash (not deleted)
A Manifest with all entries verified exists in Files/_system/manifests

evals.name: first-setup
evals.prompt: 我刚换了新 Mac，桌面和下载已经开始乱了。帮我建一套固定的文件分类，把现在的东西都归进去，以后截图也别再堆在桌面上。直接做，不用再找我确认。
evals.expected_output: Root ~/Files is created from the default config with numbered Categories, a config and README; all items are filed (passport scan into the Sensitive Zone); the screenshot-location change to the Capture Inbox is written down; a verified Manifest exists.
files: fixture: no Root yet; Downloads with invoice, passport scan, installer, photo, pptx, srt; Desktop with a sprint-board screenshot PNG, rental contract, cat video
assertions: Root ~/Files created with >=5 numbered Categories
Downloads and Desktop are empty
passport-scan.jpg is in a sensitive Category
No file lost: every original file's content still exists in the sandbox (Trash included)
Screenshot location change to an inbox under Files is written down
A Manifest with all entries verified exists in Files/_system/manifests
Machine config recorded at Files/_system/config.json

evals.name: undo-last-run
evals.prompt: 上次整理把我下载文件夹里的东西搬走了，我现在找不到了。帮我把上次整理的全部恢复回原来的位置，直接弄就行。
evals.expected_output: The latest Manifest is rolled back with the script: all three files are back in Downloads, nothing is left in Files, and every Manifest entry carries restored_at.
files: fixture: one previous run moved three Downloads files into Files and wrote a Manifest
assertions: All 3 files are back in Downloads
No copies remain inside Files
The Manifest records the restore (restored_at on every entry)
No file lost: every original file's content still exists in the sandbox (Trash included)

evals.name: windows-two-drives-zh-naming
evals.prompt: 我的 Windows 电脑有 C 盘和 D 盘，第一次用这个技能。帮我把下载和桌面整理到 D 盘，目录用中文。桌面上有些快捷方式，别弄坏了。已经装好的软件安装包也清掉。直接执行。
evals.expected_output: Setup starts from default-config.json; the agent records C: and D: roles in drives (asking or stating what it assumed), sets naming zh and writes Chinese Category ids with two-digit prefixes, Root on D: outside system folders. Folders that desktop shortcuts point into stay in place; when the host can run shortcuts.ps1 it is used to check them, otherwise the report says why it was skipped. Installers of installed apps go through the quarantine action, never trash or the Recycle Bin. A verified Manifest is written.
files: fixture: mock two drives by patching file_tidy.volume_root (unit tests) or, under WSL, use fresh temp dirs on two real drives; C-side profile with Downloads (invoice PDF, an installer of an installed app, a photo) and Desktop (a .lnk to a standalone game folder that the user moves, a work docx); no Root yet
assertions: config.json drives has entries for both C: and D:
config naming is zh and every Category id matches ^\d\d_ followed by Chinese characters
The Root is on D: and not under Users, Program Files, ProgramData or Windows

The drives entries come from the user's answers or from assumptions stated in the report, not copied from a fixed template (config.json contains no template text such as 'Removable USB drive' or 'E:\Files')
No folder that a desktop shortcut points into was moved; if the host cannot run shortcuts.ps1, the report states why it was skipped
The installer is under D:\_quarantine\<stamp>\ or C:\_quarantine\<stamp>\ (same drive as its source); no Plan item uses action trash
A Manifest with all entries verified exists under <Root>\_system\manifests
config drives lists only the drives the user mentioned (C: and D:); no E:, F: or G: entries

evals.name: macos-downloads-content-sensitive
evals.prompt: 帮我整理一下 Mac 的下载文件夹，按 ~/Files 规则来。直接执行就行。
evals.expected_output: Unnamed items are classified by looking at content: a CSV of expenses into 30_finance, a screenshot of a meeting agenda into 20_work. A .env file goes to 99_sensitive without being opened or printed. A screenshot whose content is unclear stays in Downloads and is listed with what was seen. A verified Manifest is written.
files: fixture: existing ~/Files Root with default config; Downloads with report.csv (expense rows), Screenshot 2026-05-01.png (meeting agenda), Screenshot 2026-05-02.png (blank gradient), project.env containing API_KEY=..., a pdf invoice
assertions: report.csv is under Files/30_finance
The agenda screenshot is under Files/20_work
project.env is under Files/99_sensitive
The transcript never contains the .env file's value
The unclear screenshot is still in Downloads and is named in the report with what was seen
A Manifest with all entries verified exists in Files/_system/manifests
An invoice whose owner (personal or company) cannot be determined is filed without guessing a personal/company subfolder and is named in the report for the user to confirm

evals.name: dupes-and-removal
evals.prompt: 我的照片备份目录里好多重复的，帮我去重，重复的别直接删。直接按计划执行。
evals.expected_output: dupes is run first. For each byte-identical group one copy stays in the better location and the others go to trash (macOS/Linux) or quarantine (Windows drive). A Live Photo HEIC+MOV pair is kept or removed together. Files under a .thumbnails cache are not treated as duplicates. Hard-linked files are not reported as duplicates and no new hard links are created.
files: fixture: Photos/ and Backup/ with the same IMG_0001.HEIC + IMG_0001.MOV pair in both, a byte-identical PDF in both, Backup/.thumbnails/ holding copies of the photos, and a pair of hard links to one file
assertions: dupes was run before the Plan was written
Exactly one copy of each duplicate group remains outside trash/_quarantine, and the others are in trash or _quarantine (none deleted)
On Linux, every copy moved to Trash/files has a matching Trash/info/<name>.trashinfo
IMG_0001.HEIC and IMG_0001.MOV end up in the same place (both kept or both removed)
Nothing under .thumbnails is moved
The hard-linked pair is untouched and no file has a higher st_nlink than before
A Manifest with all entries verified is written
